root_cause_pinned: Real stack trace (db-jest.log): backend/src/services/listing.service.js:201 calculateQualityScore did `SELECT business_name, city, category FROM brands` — `city` lives on `users` (brand register does UPDATE users SET city; `brands` has no city col). NOT campaign.controller (earlier guess; stack trace authoritative).
fix: Minimal: `SELECT b.business_name, u.city, b.category FROM brands b JOIN users u ON u.id=b.user_id WHERE b.id=$1`. Result shape (business_name,city,category) unchanged → quality-rule scoring behaviour preserved. No refactor, no logic change.
